# Devil's Advocate Review Contrarian thinker who stress-tests ideas, assumptions, and proposals — challenges whether features should exist at all Challenge necessity: question whether the feature or change is truly needed Challenge assumptions: identify unstated premises and question whether they hold Expose costs: surface hidden complexity, maintenance burden, and opportunity costs Explore alternatives: propose at least one credible alternative to every recommendation Demand evidence: reject hand-waving, require concrete data or reasoning for claims Surface hidden risks: find failure modes, edge cases, and second-order consequences Critique ideas, never people | Always provide constructive counter-proposals | Back objections with evidence-based reasoning, not mere contrarianism | Acknowledge when the original position is genuinely strong | Stay focused on the specific proposal - no tangential objections 1. Identify core claims → 2. Surface hidden assumptions → 3. Construct strongest counter-argument → 4. Enumerate risks and failure modes → 5. Propose alternatives → 6. Synthesize balanced assessment Per challenge: claim under scrutiny, counter-argument, evidence, risk level (low/medium/high), alternative. Risk flags for critical failure/harm scenarios. Alternatives with trade-off analysis. CONSTRUCTIVE (improves the outcome) | SPECIFIC (names exact risks) | BALANCED (acknowledges strengths) | EVIDENCE-BASED (reasoning not opinion) Analysis checklists PROCEED | RECONSIDER | ABANDON H001: Keystone Operator Packaging CC-0017 **Size:** 🔨 medium **Category:** infrastructure **Priority:** high ## Open Questions All questions resolved by user decisions. No remaining ambiguities. ## Summary Create the packaging layer for the Keystone operator: a multi-stage Dockerfile (Go 1.25 builder → distroless runtime), a Helm chart with all deployment manifests (Deployment, Service, ServiceAccount, RBAC, webhook configs, CRDs), and a FluxCD HelmRelease to deploy it via GitOps. This connects the existing operator code (`operators/keystone/`) to the existing FluxCD deployment pipeline (`deploy/flux-system/`), completing Phase 8 (S017) of the project plan. ## Scope **Included:** - `operators/keystone/Dockerfile` — multi-stage build (golang:1.25 builder, gcr.io/distroless/static:nonroot runtime, CGO_ENABLED=0, UID 65532). Build context must be workspace root to resolve `go.work` and `internal/common` dependency. - `operators/keystone/helm/keystone-operator/Chart.yaml` — apiVersion v2, chart metadata - `operators/keystone/helm/keystone-operator/values.yaml` — image, replicas (default 2), resources, leaderElection (default true), webhook, metrics, serviceAccount - `operators/keystone/helm/keystone-operator/crds/keystone.openstack.c5c3.io_keystones.yaml` — CRD copied from `config/crd/bases/` - `operators/keystone/helm/keystone-operator/templates/deployment.yaml` - `operators/keystone/helm/keystone-operator/templates/service.yaml` - `operators/keystone/helm/keystone-operator/templates/serviceaccount.yaml` - `operators/keystone/helm/keystone-operator/templates/clusterrole.yaml` - `operators/keystone/helm/keystone-operator/templates/clusterrolebinding.yaml` - `operators/keystone/helm/keystone-operator/templates/webhook-configuration.yaml` (both MutatingWebhookConfiguration and ValidatingWebhookConfiguration) - `operators/keystone/helm/keystone-operator/templates/_helpers.tpl` - `deploy/flux-system/releases/keystone-operator.yaml` — FluxCD HelmRelease targeting `openstack` namespace - Update `deploy/flux-system/kustomization.yaml` to include the new HelmRelease resource **Excluded:** - CI/CD workflows for building/pushing operator image or Helm chart (S018 — separate feature) - Makefile `docker-build` and `helm-package` target implementations (separate feature per PLAN.md) - `values-prod.yaml` or environment-specific overrides (YAGNI) - `NOTES.txt` post-install template (YAGNI) - Helm chart tests (YAGNI for initial packaging) - HelmRepository source for c5c3-charts (`deploy/flux-system/sources/c5c3-charts.yaml` already exists) - Monitoring/alerting resources — PrometheusRule, ServiceMonitor (separate concern) - New namespace manifest (`openstack` already exists in `namespaces.yaml`) ## Visualization ```mermaid flowchart TD subgraph build ["Dockerfile - Multi-stage Build"] B1["golang:1.25 builder"] B2["CGO_ENABLED=0 go build"] B3["distroless/static:nonroot"] B1 --> B2 --> B3 end subgraph helm ["Helm Chart - keystone-operator"] CH["Chart.yaml"] VA["values.yaml"] CRD["crds/keystones.yaml"] subgraph templates ["templates/"] DEP["deployment.yaml"] SVC["service.yaml"] SA["serviceaccount.yaml"] CR["clusterrole.yaml"] CRB["clusterrolebinding.yaml"] MWH["mutating-webhook-config"] VWH["validating-webhook-config"] HLP["_helpers.tpl"] end end subgraph flux ["FluxCD GitOps"] SRC["HelmRepository: c5c3-charts
oci://ghcr.io/c5c3/charts"] HR["HelmRelease: keystone-operator"] SRC --> HR end B3 -->|"image referenced by"| VA VA -->|"configures"| templates HR -->|"deploys chart"| helm ``` ```mermaid sequenceDiagram participant FC as FluxCD participant HR as HelmRelease participant H as Helm participant K as Kubernetes participant CM as cert-manager FC->>HR: Reconcile keystone-operator Note over HR: dependsOn: cert-manager,

Builder stage uses `golang:1.25`, copies `go.work`, `go.sum`, and all three module directories (`internal/common/`, `operators/keystone/`, `operators/c5c3/`) for workspace-aware dependency resolution. Builds with `CGO_ENABLED=0 GOOS=linux go build -a -o manager ./operators/keystone/main.go`. Runtime stage copies binary to `gcr.io/distroless/static:nonroot`, runs as UID 65532:65532. Docker build context is workspace root (`/workspace`), not `operators/keystone/`. - **`Chart.yaml`**: Chart name `keystone-operator`, apiVersion `v2`, type `application`, version `0.1.0`, appVersion `0.1.0`. - **`values.yaml`**: Configurable image (repo/tag/pullPolicy), replicas (default 2), resource requests/limits, leaderElection toggle (default true), webhook enable/disable, metrics port (default 8080 — matches bootstrap default `--metrics-bind-address :8080`), serviceAccount name/create flag. - **`crds/keystone.openstack.c5c3.io_keystones.yaml`**: Copy of generated CRD from `config/crd/bases/`. Helm auto-installs CRDs from `crds/` directory before templates. - **`templates/deployment.yaml`**: Operator Deployment using `bootstrap.Run()` flags: `--leader-elect={{ .Values.leaderElection.enabled }}`, `--metrics-bind-address=:{{ .Values.metrics.port }}`, `--health-probe-bind-address=:8081`. Liveness/readiness probes on `:8081` (`/healthz`, `/readyz`). Security context: non-root, read-only rootfs, drop ALL capabilities, `allowPrivilegeEscalation: false`, `runAsNonRoot: true`. Resource limits from values. Webhook port 9443 exposed on container. - **`templates/service.yaml`**: ClusterIP service exposing webhook port (443→9443) and metrics port (8080). - **`templates/serviceaccount.yaml`**: Conditionally created SA via `{{ if .Values.serviceAccount.create }}`. - **`templates/clusterrole.yaml`**: RBAC rules derived from `+kubebuilder:rbac` markers in `keystone_controller.go`: - `keystone.openstack.c5c3.io`: keystones, keystones/status, keystones/finalizers - `apps`: deployments - `""` (core): services, configmaps, secrets, serviceaccounts, events - `batch`: jobs, cronjobs - `k8s.mariadb.com`: databases, users, grants - `external-secrets.io`: externalsecrets, pushsecrets - `rbac.authorization.k8s.io`: roles, rolebindings - **`templates/clusterrolebinding.yaml`**: Binds ClusterRole to the operator's ServiceAccount in the `openstack` namespace. - **`templates/webhook-configuration.yaml`**: Both `MutatingWebhookConfiguration` (defaulting, path `/mutate-keystone-openstack-c5c3-io-v1alpha1-keystone`, operations: CREATE+UPDATE, name: `mkeystone.kb.io`) and `ValidatingWebhookConfiguration` (validation, path `/validate-keystone-openstack-c5c3-io-v1alpha1-keystone`, operations: CREATE+UPDATE+DELETE, name: `vkeystone.kb.io`). Both with `failurePolicy: Fail`, `sideEffects: None`, and `cert-manager.io/inject-ca-from` annotation for automatic CA bundle injection. - **`templates/_helpers.tpl`**: Standard helpers — `fullname`, `name`, `chart`, `labels`, `selectorLabels`, `serviceAccountName`. - **`deploy/flux-system/releases/keystone-operator.yaml`**: HelmRelease (apiVersion `helm.toolkit.fluxcd.io/v2`) targeting `openstack` namespace. References `c5c3-charts` OCI HelmRepository (namespace `flux-system`). `dependsOn: [cert-manager, mariadb-operator, memcached-operator]` with correct namespace references. `install.crds: CreateReplace`, `upgrade.crds: CreateReplace`, `remediation.retries: 3`. Version range `>=0.1.0 <1.0.0`. Interval `30m`. Values override: `replicas: 2`, `leaderElection.enabled: true`. - **`deploy/flux-system/kustomization.yaml`**: Add `releases/keystone-operator.yaml` to the resources list (alongside existing releases).
